description: Add API version discovery and normalized read-only access to application sync state, indexer capabilities, and health using synthetic responses.
acceptance: Application links and sync settings normalize into the core capability model.
Indexer data is summarized without persisting sensitive query or history data.
Synthetic fixtures prove success, unsupported version, and redaction behavior.
The adapter reuses transport-01 for endpoint policy, credentials, retries, typed failures, and redaction rather than implementing a private HTTP stack.
Fast synthetic fixture tests and a focused real-container prowlarr lane both pass.
Read-only operation performs no domain mutation; any required authentication session is explicitly classified and side-effect-free.
